crossrefs.text: The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion.
but from the inner disposition of your heart, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in Godʼs sight.
May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servantʼs well-being.”
I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will sing out in joy.
“He trusts in the LORD, let the LORD deliver him; let the LORD rescue him, since He delights in him.”
Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.
For great is His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Hallelujah!
Yes, I will rejoice in doing them good, and I will faithfully plant them in this land with all My heart and with all My soul.
I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue.
For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
He held in His right hand seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword came from His mouth. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
And I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude, like the rushing of many waters, and like a mighty rumbling of thunder, crying out: “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.

Then the Levites—Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah—said, “Stand up and bless the LORD your God from everlasting to everlasting: Blessed be Your glorious name, and may it be exalted above all blessing and praise.
For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
